description: This file manages Windows scheduled tasks and startup entries for a gateway service, including creating, updating, stopping, restarting, and querying scheduled tasks and startup items, with detailed handling of process termination and port inspection.

methods.name: resolveTaskName
methods.description: Determines the Windows task name based on environment variables or profile.

methods.name: shouldFallbackToStartupEntry
methods.description: Checks if error code or detail indicates fallback to startup entry.

methods.name: resolveTaskScriptPath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the scheduled task script file.

methods.name: resolveWindowsStartupDir
methods.description: Determines the Windows startup directory based on environment variables.

methods.name: sanitizeWindowsFilename
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a valid Windows filename.

methods.name: resolveStartupEntryPath
methods.description: Builds the full path to the Windows startup entry script.

methods.name: quoteSchtasksArg
methods.description: Quotes a string argument for schtasks, handling spaces and quotes.

methods.name: resolveTaskUser
methods.description: Resolves the user account to run the scheduled task under.

methods.name: readScheduledTaskCommand
methods.description: Reads and parses the command from the scheduled task script file.

methods.name: parseSchtasksQuery
methods.description: Parses the output of schtasks query into structured info.

methods.name: normalizeTaskResultCode
methods.description: Normalizes task result codes into a consistent format.

methods.name: deriveScheduledTaskRuntimeStatus
methods.description: Derives runtime status (running/stopped/unknown) from parsed task info.

methods.name: buildTaskScript
methods.description: Constructs the content of a Windows batch script for a scheduled task.

methods.name: buildStartupLauncherScript
methods.description: Builds a script to launch the startup entry minimized.

methods.name: assertSchtasksAvailable
methods.description: Checks if schtasks is available on the system.

methods.name: isStartupEntryInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the Windows startup entry script exists.

methods.name: isRegisteredScheduledTask
methods.description: Checks if the scheduled task is registered with schtasks.

methods.name: launchFallbackTaskScript
methods.description: Launches the startup script as a detached process.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredGatewayPort
methods.description: Resolves the gateway port from environment variables.

methods.name: parsePositivePort
methods.description: Parses a string as a positive port number.

methods.name: parsePortFromProgramArguments
methods.description: Extracts port number from command line arguments.

methods.name: resolveScheduledTaskPort
methods.description: Resolves the port used by the scheduled task, via command or config.

methods.name: resolveScheduledTaskGatewayListenerPids
methods.description: Finds PIDs of gateway listeners on a port.

methods.name: terminateScheduledTaskGatewayListeners
methods.description: Terminates gateway listener processes on a port.

methods.name: isProcessAlive
methods.description: Checks if a process with given PID is alive.

methods.name: waitForProcessExit
methods.description: Waits for a process to exit within a timeout.

methods.name: terminateGatewayProcessTree
methods.description: Terminates a process and its children, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: waitForGatewayPortRelease
methods.description: Waits until a port is free.

methods.name: terminateBusyPortListeners
methods.description: Terminates processes listening on a busy port.

methods.name: resolveFallbackRuntime
methods.description: Resolves runtime info when scheduled task info is unavailable.

methods.name: stopStartupEntry
methods.description: Stops the Windows startup entry process.

methods.name: terminateInstalledStartupRuntime
methods.description: Terminates the startup process if installed.

methods.name: restartStartupEntry
methods.description: Restarts the Windows startup process.

methods.name: writeScheduledTaskScript
methods.description: Creates the script file for a scheduled task.

methods.name: stageScheduledTask
methods.description: Prepares and stages the scheduled task script.

methods.name: updateExistingScheduledTask
methods.description: Updates an existing scheduled task with a new script.

methods.name: runScheduledTaskOrThrow
methods.description: Runs a scheduled task, throws on failure.

methods.name: activateScheduledTask
methods.description: Creates or updates the scheduled task and handles fallback.

methods.name: installScheduledTask
methods.description: Stages and activates a scheduled task.

methods.name: uninstallScheduledTask
methods.description: Removes scheduled task, startup entry, and script files.

methods.name: isTaskNotRunning
methods.description: Checks if the schtasks output indicates task is not running.

methods.name: stopScheduledTask
methods.description: Stops the scheduled task or startup entry, terminates processes, and releases port.

methods.name: restartScheduledTask
methods.description: Stops and restarts the scheduled task or startup entry.

methods.name: isScheduledTaskInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the scheduled task or startup entry is installed.

methods.name: readScheduledTaskRuntime
methods.description: Reads runtime status of the scheduled task or startup item.
